title: Tanzanian Chicken Wings
community: Urban Tanzania — popular restaurant and bar food
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Chicken Wings — chicken wings marinated in Zanzibar spices and tamarind, baked until crispy, then glazed with a honey-tamarind glaze. The most popular restaurant starter in Dar es Salaam — sweet, sticky, and powerfully spiced.
longDesc: Tanzanian chicken wings carry the full flavour profile of the coast — tamarind, honey, and Zanzibar spices create a glaze that is simultaneously sweet, tart, and aromatic. At Dar es Salaam's most popular restaurants, these disappear faster than anything else on the menu.
steps: Mix marinade. Coat wings. Marinate 2 hours.
Place on rack. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Make glaze: simmer all glaze ingredients 3 minutes.
Brush wings with glaze. Bake 5 minutes. Flip. Glaze again. Bake 5 more minutes.
Serve with extra glaze for dipping.
chefTips: Multiple glaze applications build the lacquer.
cookingScience: See KEN272 for chicken wing cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Wings use a part of the chicken that would otherwise be undervalued.
culturalNote: Tanzanian tamarind-glazed chicken wings are the social food of Dar es Salaam's restaurant scene — the starter that orders itself and the dish people return specifically to eat.
